name: cinematic
character: cinematic cue (build, hit, release): judged like a melodic piece, but may have no lead so it falls back to layer balance

focus.label: a figure, a texture or a drone carrying the scene
focus.reason: a cue may be led by a line, by a texture or by a held drone; all three are the scene's centre

pattern.loop_short.reason: a cue holds a pad, a drone or an ostinato for a whole section on purpose; 6 % of the bars differing is the floor, so a part that never changes is still flagged while a section-level bed is not
